quran_text_all_rows.arabic_uthmani: لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍۢ
تَنَزَّلُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمْرٍۢ

butuncul_okuma_all_lines.raw_line: **97:0.** بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ — Birincil okuma: Başlangıç, Allah’ın adıyla yapılan merhametli bir açılıştır. Sonraki iniş, izin ve emir dili bu açılışı yalnızca dua formülü olmaktan çıkarıp bütün gece-hadisesinin yetki mührü ve rahim gibi koruyucu kabı hâline getirir. {س م و B005; ء ل ه B002; ر ح م B001; ر ح م B003; ء ذ ن B004; ء م ر B002}
butuncul_okuma_all_lines.reading_text_tr: Başlangıç, Allah’ın adıyla yapılan merhametli bir açılıştır. Sonraki iniş, izin ve emir dili bu açılışı yalnızca dua formülü olmaktan çıkarıp bütün gece-hadisesinin yetki mührü ve rahim gibi koruyucu kabı hâline getirir.

butuncul_okuma_all_lines.raw_line: **97:1.** إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةِ ٱلْقَدْرِ — Birincil okuma: O şey, kadir gecesine indirilmiştir. Bütün bağlam okununca bu iniş, yalnızca yukarıdan aşağıya hareket değil, ölçülmüş bir vakte yerleştirme, karanlık bir kapta yoğunlaştırma ve sonunda güvenle teslim edilecek bir nimet gibi görünür. {ن ز ل B002; ن ز ل B004; ن ز ل B005; ل ي ل B001; ق د ر B001; ق د ر B005; ق د ر B006}
butuncul_okuma_all_lines.reading_text_tr: O şey, kadir gecesine indirilmiştir. Bütün bağlam okununca bu iniş, yalnızca yukarıdan aşağıya hareket değil, ölçülmüş bir vakte yerleştirme, karanlık bir kapta yoğunlaştırma ve sonunda güvenle teslim edilecek bir nimet gibi görünür.

butuncul_okuma_all_lines.raw_line: **97:2.** وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ — Birincil okuma: Soru, muhatabın kadir gecesinin ne olduğunu kavramaya çağrılmasıdır. Sonraki izin, bildirme, doğuş ve açılma imgeleri bu bilgiyi insanın zorla elde ettiği bir sonuç değil, karanlıkta saklı olanın yetkili biçimde açılması olarak değiştirir. {د ر ي B001; د ر ي B003; د ر ي B004; ل ي ل B001; ق د ر B001; ء ذ ن B003; ط ل ع B003; ف ج ر B001}
butuncul_okuma_all_lines.reading_text_tr: Soru, muhatabın kadir gecesinin ne olduğunu kavramaya çağrılmasıdır. Sonraki izin, bildirme, doğuş ve açılma imgeleri bu bilgiyi insanın zorla elde ettiği bir sonuç değil, karanlıkta saklı olanın yetkili biçimde açılması olarak değiştirir.

butuncul_okuma_all_lines.raw_line: **97:3.** لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍۢ — Birincil okuma: Kadir gecesi bin aydan daha hayırlıdır. Bağlam bu üstünlüğü basit bir sayı hesabından çıkarıp ölçünün niteliğine, çok parçalı zamanın tek bir bütün işte toplanmasına ve barışçı inişin görünür güç gösterilerinden üstün oluşuna çevirir. {ل ي ل B001; ق د ر B001; ق د ر B006; خ ي ر B001; خ ي ر B002; ء ل ف B001; ء ل ف B002; ش ه ر B001; ش ه ر B003; ك ل ل B003; س ل م B004}
butuncul_okuma_all_lines.arabic_text: لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍۢ
butuncul_okuma_all_lines.reading_text_tr: Kadir gecesi bin aydan daha hayırlıdır. Bağlam bu üstünlüğü basit bir sayı hesabından çıkarıp ölçünün niteliğine, çok parçalı zamanın tek bir bütün işte toplanmasına ve barışçı inişin görünür güç gösterilerinden üstün oluşuna çevirir.

butuncul_okuma_all_lines.raw_line: **97:4.** تَنَزَّلُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمْرٍۢ — Birincil okuma: Melekler ve Ruh, Rablerinin izniyle her iş için o gecede iner. Diğer ayetler bu sahneyi kalabalık bir mucize görüntüsünden çıkarıp işiten, izin alan, hayat veren, kuşatan ve işleri merhametle olgunlaştıran düzenli bir emir alayına dönüştürür. {ن ز ل B002; م ل ك B003; م ل ك B008; ر و ح B001; ر و ح B003; ر و ح B007; ء ذ ن B002; ء ذ ن B004; ر ب ب B001; ر ب ب B002; ك ل ل B003; ك ل ل B005; ء م ر B001; ء م ر B002; ء م ر B004}
butuncul_okuma_all_lines.arabic_text: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمْرٍۢ
butuncul_okuma_all_lines.reading_text_tr: Melekler ve Ruh, Rablerinin izniyle her iş için o gecede iner. Diğer ayetler bu sahneyi kalabalık bir mucize görüntüsünden çıkarıp işiten, izin alan, hayat veren, kuşatan ve işleri merhametle olgunlaştıran düzenli bir emir alayına dönüştürür.

butuncul_okuma_all_lines.raw_line: **97:5.** سَلَٰمٌ هِىَ حَتَّىٰ مَطْلَعِ ٱلْفَجْرِ — Birincil okuma: O gece, fecrin doğuş yerine kadar selamdır. Önceki iniş, ölçü, gizlilik ve rahmet okumaları bu selamı pasif bir huzur değil, indirilen şeyin korunduğu, güvenle devredildiği ve fecrin yarılışıyla görünür kılındığı bir eşik yapar. {س ل م B001; س ل م B004; س ل م B006; س ل م B012; ط ل ع B001; ط ل ع B003; ط ل ع B006; ف ج ر B001; ف ج ر B002}
butuncul_okuma_all_lines.reading_text_tr: O gece, fecrin doğuş yerine kadar selamdır. Önceki iniş, ölçü, gizlilik ve rahmet okumaları bu selamı pasif bir huzur değil, indirilen şeyin korunduğu, güvenle devredildiği ve fecrin yarılışıyla görünür kılındığı bir eşik yapar.

parent_channels.name: Determination, Arrangement, and Authorized Action

subchannels.name: Deliberating and Fitting an Affair
subchannels.scene_or_process: A matter is considered, its parts assembled around a mainstay, and each part put in its suitable place.
subchannels.active_motifs: measured deliberation (ق د ر:B005/m01); fitting and preparation (ق د ر:B005/m02); affair or circumstance (ء م ر:B001/m01); consultation (ء م ر:B007/m01); assembly after separation (ء ل ف:B002/m01); proper placement (ن ز ل:B004/m01); governing mainstay (م ل ك:B005/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Deliberation supplies the measure, consultation tests it, assembly joins the components, and the mainstay holds the resulting arrangement together. Ordered placement completes the process by assigning each component its appropriate station.

subchannels.name: Permissioned Command and Complete Dispatch
subchannels.scene_or_process: A sovereign command grants leave and sends an ordered charge downward in its entirety.
subchannels.active_motifs: permission to act (ء ذ ن:B004/m01); binding command (ء م ر:B002/m01); lordship (ر ب ب:B001/m01); sovereignty (م ل ك:B003/m01); complete inclusion (ك ل ل:B003/m01); sending and delivery (ن ز ل:B002/m01); recurring angelic descent (ن ز ل:B002/m03)
subchannels.synthesis: Authority originates the command, permission opens the route for action, and descent delivers the charge. The language of totality makes the dispatch comprehensive rather than fragmentary.

subchannels.name: Selecting the Beneficial Course
subchannels.scene_or_process: Deliberation compares alternatives and chooses the course marked by benefit and excellence.
subchannels.active_motifs: evaluative planning (ق د ر:B005/m01); choosing the better option (خ ي ر:B003/m01); beneficial good (خ ي ر:B001/m01); selected excellence (خ ي ر:B002/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Measure is not only quantitative: it becomes a decision procedure. Reflection distinguishes alternatives, while خير supplies both the criterion of benefit and the outcome of selection.

subchannels.name: Stewardship and Collateral Inheritance
subchannels.scene_or_process: A caretaker orders property and responsibility for a household whose succession runs through collateral kin.
subchannels.active_motifs: gradual nurture and completion (ر ب ب:B002/m01); collateral kinship and inheritance (ك ل ل:B004/m01); property under disposition (م ل ك:B002/m01); planned apportionment (ق د ر:B005/m02)
subchannels.synthesis: Nurture establishes custodial responsibility, ownership supplies the estate, and collateral kinship defines the succession problem. Measured preparation turns those relations into an apportioned household order.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: An affair becomes actionable by being assessed, fitted, assembled, and then carried out under permission and command.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; الْقَدْرِ (97:1-3), أَنزَلْنَاهُ (97:1), and تَنَزَّلُ، إِذْنِ، رَبِّهِم، أَمْرٍ (97:4) enact measured sending under authority.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The same ordering pattern extends to composition, beneficial selection, nurture, and estate stewardship.

parent_channels.name: Knowledge, Hearing, and Disclosure

subchannels.name: Learning and Public Proclamation
subchannels.scene_or_process: Knowledge is acquired, taught, and converted into a call that reaches a public audience.
subchannels.active_motifs: knowing and teaching (د ر ي:B001/m01); acquired knowledge (ء ذ ن:B003/m01); proclamation by a call (ء ذ ن:B003/m02); learned sage (ر ب ب:B003/m01); public visibility (ش ه ر:B002/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Private cognition becomes communicable knowledge through the learned figure, then crosses into public space through proclamation. شهرة supplies the final state in which what was known is now manifest among people.

subchannels.name: Listening, Leave, and Compliance
subchannels.scene_or_process: A hearer attends to a command, receives leave, and either complies intelligently or follows without independent judgment.
subchannels.active_motifs: attentive listening and acceptance (ء ذ ن:B002/m01); granted permission (ء ذ ن:B004/m01); obligatory command (ء م ر:B002/m01); compliant dependent follower (ء م ر:B008/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: The ear-to-action sequence moves from reception to authorization and then obedience. The follower motif introduces a role reversal within the same frame: compliance can express disciplined acceptance or the absence of independent counsel.

subchannels.name: Inspection, Appearance, and Visible Aspect
subchannels.scene_or_process: An observer seeks access to a concealed condition until a person, view, or fact comes into sight.
subchannels.active_motifs: inspecting an inner matter (ط ل ع:B003/m01); appearing before a group (ط ل ع:B002/m01); repeated peeking and visual desire (ط ل ع:B008/m01); visible aspect or visage (ط ل ع:B009/m01); public emergence (ش ه ر:B002/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Looking begins as an effort to uncover what is hidden, becomes repeated visual approach, and resolves in a visible aspect. Publicity scales that local act of seeing into collective recognition.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Hidden or unknown content becomes available through learning, attentive reception, authorization, inspection, or public announcement.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; أَدْرَىٰكَ (97:2) poses knowledge as access, while إِذْنِ and أَمْرٍ (97:4) connect reception to authorized action.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Disclosure ranges from scholarship and proclamation to bodily peeking, visible aspect, and reconnaissance.

parent_channels.name: Number, Duration, and Proportion

subchannels.name: Thousand, Multitude, and Totality
subchannels.scene_or_process: A counted thousand expands into assembled multitudes and an encompassing whole.
subchannels.active_motifs: the number one thousand (ء ل ف:B001/m01); calendrical month (ش ه ر:B001/m01); bounded quantity (ق د ر:B001/m01); gathered multitudes (ر ب ب:B004/m01); collective groups (ك ل ل:B009/m01); encompassing totality (ك ل ل:B003/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: ألف supplies exact count, شهر turns it into duration, and قدر frames the comparison as bounded magnitude. The group and totality motifs show the same arithmetic logic at collective scale.

subchannels.name: Appointed Span and Single Occurrence
subchannels.scene_or_process: A marked interval is bounded by an appointed limit and can be counted as one occurrence within a larger cycle.
subchannels.active_motifs: appointed limit or term (ق د ر:B001/m02); sign and fixed time (ء م ر:B005/m01); the nearest or current night (ل ي ل:B003/m01); one instance of descent (ن ز ل:B010/m01); calendar calculation (ق د ر:B005/m03)
subchannels.synthesis: A term establishes the boundary, a sign identifies it, and deixis locates the relevant night. The single-descent motif makes an event countable inside the calculated span.

subchannels.name: Fitted Stature and Bodily Proportion
subchannels.scene_or_process: A body is read through balanced fit, width, height, chest, and articulated extremities.
subchannels.active_motifs: proportionate fit (ق د ر:B006/m01); medium stature (ق د ر:B006/m02); bodily spread or width (ر و ح:B009/m01); compact stout build (ك ل ل:B008/m01); projecting height (ط ل ع:B012/m01); chest (ك ل ل:B007/m01); finger and foot joints (س ل م:B010/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Proportion acts as the invariant across otherwise contrasting forms: medium, broad, compact, tall, axial, and jointed. Each motif locates fit in a different bodily dimension.

subchannels.name: Narrowed Resources and Constrained Capacity
subchannels.scene_or_process: Property and agency contract under scarcity, producing need, burden, and an obligation that must be restored.
subchannels.active_motifs: constricted provision (ق د ر:B004/m01); property under control (م ل ك:B002/m01); pressing need (ر ب ب:B016/m01); tight knot (ر ب ب:B016/m02); dependent burden (ك ل ل:B002/m01); restitution of a due right (ر و ح:B006/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Constriction reduces available property and turns dependency into weight. Need tightens the relation further, while restitution names the action that releases the obligation.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Measure bounds phenomena as count, temporal span, fitted form, or restricted capacity.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; الْقَدْرِ (97:1-3) and أَلْفِ شَهْرٍ (97:3) explicitly couple valuation with numerical and calendrical scale.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Numerical measure extends into crowds, bodily build, property limits, need, and burden.

parent_channels.name: Night, Darkness, and Dawn

subchannels.name: Dark Interval and Nocturnal Practice
subchannels.scene_or_process: Night establishes the setting for actions, journeys, and evening return.
subchannels.active_motifs: night and its darkness (ل ي ل:B001/m01); acting or traveling by night (ل ي ل:B002/m01); the present night (ل ي ل:B003/m01); evening movement and return (ر و ح:B005/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: The night is both a temporal container and a mode of action. Nocturnal practice fills that interval, while evening return gives it directional rhythm.

subchannels.name: Dawn as Rupture and Rising Light
subchannels.scene_or_process: Darkness is split open and light rises from the breach.
subchannels.active_motifs: dawn light (ف ج ر:B002/m01); broad splitting and release (ف ج ر:B001/m01); rising luminary and point of emergence (ط ل ع:B001/m01); night darkness (ل ي ل:B001/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Fajr supplies both the concrete dawn and the mechanics of opening; طلوع supplies upward appearance. Together they make dawn a transition generated by rupture rather than a mere timestamp.

subchannels.name: Peace Extending to the Dawn Boundary
subchannels.scene_or_process: Safety and reconciliation fill the night until the marked point of dawn.
subchannels.active_motifs: freedom from harm (س ل م:B001/m01); peace opposed to conflict (س ل م:B004/m01); night interval (ل ي ل:B001/m01); dawn endpoint (ف ج ر:B002/m01); rising boundary (ط ل ع:B001/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: سلام defines the condition maintained inside the night, while مطلع الفجر supplies its terminal boundary. The reconciliation sense enlarges personal safety into a social suspension of conflict.

subchannels.name: Enclosing Cloud, Canopy, and Flash
subchannels.scene_or_process: Layered cloud closes around the dark sky like a crown or canopy, then flashes from within.
subchannels.active_motifs: encircling cloud-crown (ك ل ل:B005/m02); layered rain cloud (ر ب ب:B008/m01); protective canopy (ك ل ل:B006/m01); cloud flashing like exposed teeth (ك ل ل:B011/m02); night darkness (ل ي ل:B001/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Enclosure links crown, canopy, and layered cloud into one sky architecture. The lightning motif interrupts that enclosure with a brief internal disclosure.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A bounded dark interval contains nocturnal activity, holds a state of peace, and ends through rupture and rising light.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; لَيْلَةِ الْقَدْرِ (97:1-3) is the governing interval, and سَلَامٌ هِيَ حَتَّىٰ مَطْلَعِ الْفَجْرِ (97:5) gives its state and endpoint.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Darkness also takes the form of an enclosing canopy or cloud-crown lit from within.

parent_channels.name: Descent, Position, and Reception

subchannels.name: Sending and Repeated Descent
subchannels.scene_or_process: Something is sent from above, arrives below, and may descend repeatedly rather than once.
subchannels.active_motifs: downward movement and arrival (ن ز ل:B001/m01); sending and delivery (ن ز ل:B002/m01); revelatory sending (ن ز ل:B002/m02); repeated angelic descent (ن ز ل:B002/m03); one descent-event (ن ز ل:B010/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: The root alternates causative sending with self-movement downward. Revelation, angelic arrival, and the countable descent-event are distinct roles within the same vertical process.

subchannels.name: Station, Rank, and Proper Placement
subchannels.scene_or_process: Arrival is completed by assigning a thing its dwelling, rank, or fitting position.
subchannels.active_motifs: dwelling or station (ن ز ل:B003/m01); rank or standing (ن ز ل:B003/m02); placement in the proper station (ن ز ل:B004/m01); bounded measure (ق د ر:B001/m01); fitting preparation (ق د ر:B005/m02)
subchannels.synthesis: Descent does not end at motion; it establishes position. Measure selects the appropriate station, while منزلة allows the same spatial logic to become social rank.

subchannels.name: Guest Arrival and Prepared Provision
subchannels.scene_or_process: A guest arrives to find food, generosity, and eager service already prepared.
subchannels.active_motifs: guest provision (ن ز ل:B005/m01); arriving guest (ن ز ل:B005/m02); cooking vessel and stew (ق د ر:B007/m01); generous gift (خ ي ر:B005/m01); gushing bounty (ف ج ر:B005/m01); eager generosity (ر و ح:B010/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Arrival activates a reception scene: the vessel holds the meal, generosity supplies it, and eager service moves it toward the guest. The gushing image turns provision into abundance rather than bare sufficiency.

subchannels.name: Calamity and Sudden Mass Arrival
subchannels.scene_or_process: A large force appears suddenly and descends upon a community as a disruptive event.
subchannels.active_motifs: descending calamity (ن ز ل:B006/m01); sudden mass influx (ف ج ر:B003/m01); appearing or attacking a group (ط ل ع:B002/m02); gathered multitude (ر ب ب:B004/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: The scene combines vertical arrival, abrupt multiplicity, and collective exposure. A neutral multitude becomes a calamity through the speed and force of its appearance.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Downward movement resolves into delivery, stationing, welcome, or disruptive arrival.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; أَنزَلْنَاهُ (97:1) and تَنَزَّلُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ وَالرُّوحُ (97:4) foreground sending and repeated descent.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The descent family also organizes rank, hospitality, and sudden communal calamity.

parent_channels.name: Sovereignty, Capacity, and Guidance

subchannels.name: Lordship, Kingship, and Effective Capacity
subchannels.scene_or_process: A ruler possesses the capacity and jurisdiction to originate and direct an affair.
subchannels.active_motifs: lordship and mastery (ر ب ب:B001/m01); kingship and sovereignty (م ل ك:B003/m01); effective ability (ق د ر:B003/m01); office of command (ء م ر:B003/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Lordship names the superior relation, kingship its public jurisdiction, capacity its operative force, and command its institutional form. The four motifs form a single authority frame rather than four isolated titles.

subchannels.name: Ownership, Wealth, and Disposition
subchannels.scene_or_process: An owner holds property, possesses the means to act, and may convert increase into controlled wealth.
subchannels.active_motifs: ownership and disposal (م ل ك:B002/m01); possession and means (ق د ر:B003/m02); growth of wealth or people (ء م ر:B004/m01); generous abundance (خ ي ر:B005/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Capacity becomes economic when it is attached to property and disposable means. Growth and generosity then mark two possible movements of wealth: accumulation and outward gift.

subchannels.name: Cohesion, Mainstay, and Solid Build
subchannels.scene_or_process: A structure or body remains upright because a mainstay binds strong material into a compact whole.
subchannels.active_motifs: cohesion and strengthening (م ل ك:B001/m01); essential mainstay (م ل ك:B005/m01); hard stone (س ل م:B007/m01); compact stout build (ك ل ل:B008/m01); effective strength (ق د ر:B003/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Cohesion supplies the binding action, the mainstay supplies axial stability, and stone supplies resistant material. The body-build motif transfers the same mechanics from architecture to anatomy.

subchannels.name: Route, Water, Leader, and Captain
subchannels.scene_or_process: A traveling group follows a leader along a viable route secured by water and higher navigation.
subchannels.active_motifs: centerline of road or valley (م ل ك:B006/m01); water that secures a journey (م ل ك:B007/m01); leading animal followed by the herd (م ل ك:B008/m01); master of sailors (ر ب ب:B017/m01); staying-place for animals (ر ب ب:B007/m02)
subchannels.synthesis: Guidance is materially grounded: the route must be legible, water must sustain the party, and a leader must set direction. The captain extends the same logistics from land and herd movement to navigation.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Control rests on the ability to hold, own, direct, and sustain people, property, structures, or journeys.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; رَبِّهِم، الْمَلَائِكَةُ، إِذْنِ، أَمْرٍ (97:4) place agency within a hierarchy of lordship and delegated action.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Sovereign control recurs concretely as structural cohesion, route knowledge, water security, herd leadership, and nautical command.

parent_channels.name: Transfer, Covenant, and Household Care

subchannels.name: Authorized Handover and Captivity
subchannels.scene_or_process: Authority permits a person or matter to be handed over into another party's custody.
subchannels.active_motifs: handing over and relinquishing (س ل م:B012/m01); taking captive (س ل م:B013/m01); permission (ء ذ ن:B004/m01); custody and mastery over a person (م ل ك:B002/m02); binding command (ء م ر:B002/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Permission and command legitimate the transfer; تسليم describes the act, and captivity names its coercive outcome. Ownership language fixes the resulting custodial relation.

subchannels.name: Advance Payment and Deferred Delivery
subchannels.scene_or_process: A buyer advances value under an agreement for goods or provision to be delivered later.
subchannels.active_motifs: advance payment (س ل م:B005/m01); transferable property (م ل ك:B002/m01); prepared provision (ن ز ل:B005/m01); business conducted at night (ل ي ل:B002/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: The transaction separates payment from delivery while binding both in one obligation. Nocturnal practice supplies the setting, and prepared provision supplies the deferred object.

subchannels.name: Covenant, Reconciliation, and Estate Succession
subchannels.scene_or_process: A binding pact settles relations and governs the passage of property through collateral kin.
subchannels.active_motifs: covenant and protected relation (ر ب ب:B011/m01); reconciliation (س ل م:B004/m01); collateral inheritance (ك ل ل:B004/m01); estate property (م ل ك:B002/m01); planned apportionment (ق د ر:B005/m02)
subchannels.synthesis: Covenant creates the binding social frame, reconciliation removes active conflict, and inheritance tests how that frame survives a death. Planned disposition carries the estate through the collateral relation.

subchannels.name: Marriage, Fosterage, and Household Nurture
subchannels.scene_or_process: A marriage contract forms a household in which a caregiver raises a child brought from an earlier union.
subchannels.active_motifs: marriage contract (م ل ك:B004/m01); foster child or stepchild (ر ب ب:B005/m01); caregiver standing over the child (ر ب ب:B005/m02); gradual nurture (ر ب ب:B002/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Contract creates the household boundary, while fosterage defines a non-biological relation within it. Nurture supplies the ongoing action that makes the legal relation a lived one.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Social relations are stabilized by controlled transfer of persons, property, obligation, or care.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; إِذْنِ، أَمْرٍ، رَبِّهِم، الْمَلَائِكَةُ (97:4) and سَلَامٌ (97:5) provide the lexical anchors for authorization, control, and settlement.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Handover spans capture, advance payment, covenant, inheritance, marriage, and fosterage.

parent_channels.name: Constructed Means of Holding and Directed Movement

subchannels.name: Pot, Stew, Thickener, and Herb
subchannels.scene_or_process: A cook tends a measured vessel whose contents are thickened and seasoned.
subchannels.active_motifs: cooking pot (ق د ر:B007/m01); cooked stew (ق د ر:B007/m02); cook or butcher attending the pot (ق د ر:B007/m03); thick syrup or sediment (ر ب ب:B006/m01); preserving or correcting with syrup (ر ب ب:B006/m02); basil or crop leaf (ر و ح:B012/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: The pot supplies the bounded workspace, the cook controls transformation, the thickener changes consistency, and the herb changes flavor or fragrance. قدر's abstract boundedness becomes a literal vessel.

subchannels.name: Pail, Ear-Handle, and Moving Air
subchannels.scene_or_process: A handled container is lifted and worked while air moves around or through the apparatus.
subchannels.active_motifs: single-handled pail (س ل م:B011/m01); vessel ear or handle (ء ذ ن:B001/m02); wind or moving air (ر و ح:B003/m01); air-working device or vent (ر و ح:B003/m02); bounded vessel (ق د ر:B007/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: The ear-handle is the point of human grip, the pail is the load-bearing container, and moving air supplies an environmental or mechanical force. The assembly is unified by controlled transport through an attached part.

subchannels.name: Ladder, Rungs, and Vantage
subchannels.scene_or_process: A constructed stair provides staged ascent to a higher point of access or observation.
subchannels.active_motifs: ladder and means of ascent (س ل م:B006/m01); upward route and overlook (ط ل ع:B006/m01); present-night setting (ل ي ل:B003/m01); ordered positioning (ن ز ل:B004/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Ordered placement creates the rungs, the ladder converts them into a route, and the overlook is the attained function. The night setting turns the tool into a means of access through darkness.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: An artifact organizes matter or motion by enclosing contents, providing a handle, or furnishing a staged route.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; الْقَدْرِ (97:1-3), إِذْنِ، الرُّوحُ (97:4), and سَلَامٌ، مَطْلَعِ (97:5) anchor the lexical transformations into vessels, handles, airflow, and ascent.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Abstract measure, permission, spirit, peace, and emergence converge in concrete implements.

parent_channels.name: Weather, Water, Growth, and Animal Cycles

subchannels.name: Wind, Cloud, Rain, and Sprouting
subchannels.scene_or_process: Wind gathers layered cloud, rain descends, water opens the ground, and new growth appears.
subchannels.active_motifs: wind and breeze (ر و ح:B003/m01); layered rain cloud (ر ب ب:B008/m01); descending rain (ن ز ل:B001/m02); water bursting through an opening (ف ج ر:B001/m02); plant emergence (ط ل ع:B005/m01); budding after dormancy (ر و ح:B017/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: The motifs form a causal weather sequence rather than a loose nature cluster. Air organizes cloud, descent supplies rain, fissure releases water, and طلوع and تروح name the resulting emergence.

subchannels.name: Water Abundance and Sustainable Settlement
subchannels.scene_or_process: Released water gathers until it can sustain travel, encampment, and continued life.
subchannels.active_motifs: abundant gathered water (ر ب ب:B013/m01); water securing a journey or camp (م ل ك:B007/m01); complete fullness (ط ل ع:B007/m01); gushing release (ف ج ر:B001/m02)
subchannels.synthesis: Gushing marks supply, fullness marks accumulation, and the travel-water motif marks function. Water becomes socially decisive when it allows a group to hold its position.

subchannels.name: Sprouts, Fragrant Leaves, and Craft Bark
subchannels.scene_or_process: Plants emerge and persist, supplying fragrance, edible or useful leaves, and bark for craft.
subchannels.active_motifs: palm spathe or young growth (ط ل ع:B005/m01); evergreen plant (ر ب ب:B012/m01); basil and crop leaf (ر و ح:B012/m01); tanning tree and bark (س ل م:B008/m01); renewed foliage (ر و ح:B017/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Emergence and persistence define the plant cycle, while fragrance, leaf, and bark distinguish its products. The scene moves from living growth to human use without leaving the same material chain.

subchannels.name: Evening Return of a Guided Herd
subchannels.scene_or_process: A habituated herd follows its leader back to a station as evening enters.
subchannels.active_motifs: evening return of livestock (ر و ح:B005/m01); herd of cattle or camels (ر ب ب:B014/m01); leading animal followed by the rest (م ل ك:B008/m01); animal station or abiding place (ر ب ب:B007/m02); habituated domestic animals (ء ل ف:B005/m02); current night (ل ي ل:B003/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Habituation keeps the animals together, leadership gives direction, and evening return closes movement at the station. The current-night motif supplies the temporal threshold of the scene.

subchannels.name: Breeding, Birth, and Young Animals
subchannels.scene_or_process: Maturation leads to mating capacity, emission, birth, and the protected early life of the young.
subchannels.active_motifs: stallion maturation (ر و ح:B018/m01); recently delivered ewe (ر ب ب:B009/m01); newborn freshness (ر ب ب:B009/m02); young lamb (ء م ر:B009/m01); reproductive emission (ن ز ل:B009/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: The active motifs occupy successive roles in one reproductive cycle: mature sire, emission, mother after birth, and young offspring. Freshness marks the state shared by birth and early life.

subchannels.name: Growth, Bounty, and Generous Initiative
subchannels.scene_or_process: Increase accumulates as blessing and then flows outward through energetic generosity.
subchannels.active_motifs: growth and blessing (ء م ر:B004/m01); abundant benefaction (خ ي ر:B005/m01); gushing generosity (ف ج ر:B005/m01); energetic readiness to give (ر و ح:B010/m01); blessing or favor (ر ب ب:B016/m03)
subchannels.synthesis: Growth names accumulation, blessing its favorable state, zeal its activating force, and generosity its outward release. The gushing image connects material increase to social benefaction.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Air, water, vegetation, animals, and benefit circulate through recurring processes of descent, emergence, increase, and return.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; الرُّوحُ and تَنَزَّلُ (97:4), together with مَطْلَعِ الْفَجْرِ (97:5), provide the surface anchors for wind, descent, opening, and emergence.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The cycle extends from cloud and sprout to settlement water, tanning material, herd movement, breeding, and generosity.

parent_channels.name: Body, Life, and Recovery

subchannels.name: Vital Spirit and Articulated Body
subchannels.scene_or_process: Life animates a body organized around chest, extremities, joints, and sensory organs.
subchannels.active_motifs: life-giving spirit (ر و ح:B001/m01); chest (ك ل ل:B007/m01); palm (ر و ح:B014/m01); finger and foot joints (س ل م:B010/m01); anatomical ear (ء ذ ن:B001/m01); bodily mainstay (م ل ك:B005/m02)
subchannels.synthesis: Spirit supplies animation, the chest and mainstay organize the core, and palm, joints, and ear articulate action and perception. The scene turns abstract life into a structured living body.

subchannels.name: Fatigue, Rest, Health, and Death
subchannels.scene_or_process: Exertion dulls body and senses, rest restores them, health marks release from harm, and death becomes final release.
subchannels.active_motifs: dulled edge or faculty (ك ل ل:B001/m01); bodily fatigue (ك ل ل:B001/m02); weakened hearing or sight (ك ل ل:B001/m03); rest and recovered breath (ر و ح:B007/m01); bodily safety (س ل م:B001/m01); death as release (ر و ح:B016/m01); descending catarrhal episode (ن ز ل:B010/m02)
subchannels.synthesis: Fatigue is represented as loss of sharpness across limbs and senses. Rest reverses that loss, safety names restored integrity, and the language of release carries the sequence to death.

subchannels.name: Face, Grooming, and the Flash of a Smile
subchannels.scene_or_process: A face is brought into view, groomed, and animated by a smile that exposes the teeth.
subchannels.active_motifs: visible visage (ط ل ع:B009/m01); pointed grooming comb (د ر ي:B004/m02); smiling with visible teeth (ك ل ل:B011/m01); public appearance (ش ه ر:B002/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Grooming prepares the visible aspect, appearance brings it before others, and the smile makes visibility active through exposed teeth. Publicity scales the face-to-face event into a recognized presence.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Vital presence inhabits an articulated body whose senses, energy, and visible features move between vigor, fatigue, rest, and death.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; الرُّوحُ (97:4), سَلَامٌ and مَطْلَعِ (97:5), and كُلِّ (97:4) anchor the lexical extensions into life, bodily integrity, and visible form.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Cosmic and social vocabulary resolves into ears, chest, palm, joints, face, smile, illness, and recovery.

parent_channels.name: Pursuit, Weapons, and Conflict

subchannels.name: Concealed Stalking and Luring Quarry
subchannels.scene_or_process: A hunter hides behind cover, manipulates the quarry's exit, and waits for its appearance.
subchannels.active_motifs: concealed stalking (د ر ي:B003/m01); luring an animal from its burrow (خ ي ر:B006/m01); alighting into position (ن ز ل:B001/m03); quarry appearing from concealment (ط ل ع:B002/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Concealment defines the hunter's role, the lure alters the quarry's path, alighting fixes the attack position, and appearance supplies the decisive opening.

subchannels.name: Targeted Raid and Positional Approach
subchannels.scene_or_process: A raiding party selects a target, approaches it deliberately, and establishes a position before sudden arrival.
subchannels.active_motifs: purposeful raid or targeting (د ر ي:B002/m01); attacking appearance (ط ل ع:B002/m02); ordered positioning (ن ز ل:B004/m01); measured range or extent (ق د ر:B001/m01); staying in place (ر ب ب:B007/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Target selection and measured approach precede contact. Positioning and staying convert movement into tactical readiness, while sudden appearance completes the raid.

subchannels.name: Scout, Quiver, and Armed Projectile
subchannels.scene_or_process: A scout observes the opponent while weapons are drawn, fitted with points, stored, and launched.
subchannels.active_motifs: reconnaissance scout (ط ل ع:B004/m01); unsheathed weapon (ش ه ر:B003/m01); fitted spearpoint (ء م ر:B011/m01); sharpened point (د ر ي:B004/m01); quiver and gathered arrows (ر ب ب:B010/m01); arrow overshooting its mark (ط ل ع:B010/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Reconnaissance supplies information, unsheathing announces readiness, the point arms the shaft, and the quiver organizes projectiles. The overshooting arrow records the possible failure of measured launch.

subchannels.name: Duel, Violated Sanctuary, and Reconciliation
subchannels.scene_or_process: Opponents descend into formal combat, breach a protected boundary, and remain capable of returning to peace.
subchannels.active_motifs: descending to duel (ن ز ل:B007/m01); peace and reconciliation (س ل م:B004/m01); transgressive breach (ف ج ر:B004/m01); sacrilegious battle (ف ج ر:B006/m01); beneficial alternative to harm (خ ي ر:B001/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Duel gives conflict a reciprocal encounter, while فجور marks the crossing of a moral or protected boundary. سلام reverses that trajectory through reconciliation, with خير naming the beneficial alternative.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Contest unfolds through concealment, targeting, reconnaissance, weapon preparation, encounter, and either violated peace or reconciliation.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; أَدْرَىٰكَ (97:2), شَهْرٍ (97:3), أَمْرٍ (97:4), and سَلَامٌ، مَطْلَعِ الْفَجْرِ (97:5) carry the lexical branches that form the conflict scenes.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Knowledge becomes stalking, appearance becomes attack, and peace stands as the reversible outcome of duel and sacrilege.

parent_channels.name: Composition, Naming, and Lexical Framing

subchannels.name: Alif, Grammar, and Ordered Composition
subchannels.scene_or_process: Letters and particles are arranged into a composed whole whose parts occupy deliberate positions.
subchannels.active_motifs: alif as grapheme (ء ل ف:B006/m01); grammatical particle rubba (ر ب ب:B015/m01); textual composition (ء ل ف:B002/m02); deliberate arrangement (ق د ر:B005/m02); ordered placement (ن ز ل:B004/m01); complete assembly (ك ل ل:B003/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: The grapheme and particle provide linguistic components; composition joins them, measure orders them, and placement fixes their sequence. Totality names the finished text as a structured whole.

subchannels.name: Proclamation, Publicity, and Notorious Appellation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A remarkable event is announced, becomes widely visible, and acquires a public or notorious name.
subchannels.active_motifs: public call (ء ذ ن:B003/m02); fame or notoriety (ش ه ر:B002/m01); extraordinary or outrageous affair (ء م ر:B006/m01); historical naming of sacrilegious battles (ف ج ر:B006/m02)
subchannels.synthesis: The call initiates circulation, publicity broadens it, and enormity gives people a reason to preserve the event by name. The named battles show notoriety becoming historical appellation.

subchannels.name: Present Night, Layla, and Wine Epithet
subchannels.scene_or_process: Temporal deixis becomes a proper name, which in turn becomes a figurative name for wine.
subchannels.active_motifs: nearest or present night (ل ي ل:B003/m01); Layla as a personal name (ل ي ل:B004/m01); Umm Layla as wine epithet (ل ي ل:B004/m02); wine called al-rah (ر و ح:B015/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: The lexical chain moves from a temporal referent to a personal name and then to a beverage epithet. The independent wine sense of روح completes the figurative naming relation.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Language organizes meaning through letters, grammatical particles, ordered composition, public naming, deixis, and figurative appellation.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; أَلْفِ (97:3), لَيْلَةِ/لَيْلَةُ (97:1-3), شَهْرٍ (97:3), and إِذْنِ (97:4) activate lexical branches that move from utterance into writing and naming.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: A numerical ألف becomes a grapheme, a night becomes a woman's name and a wine epithet, and notoriety turns an event into a public name.

parent_channels.name: S1. Familiarity, Staying, and Home
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Repeated residence makes a place familiar until it functions as an owned or settled home.
parent_channels.active_motifs: familiarity and habitual attachment (ء ل ف:B005/m01); staying and duration (ر ب ب:B007/m01); dwelling or home (ن ز ل:B003/m01); possession of a place (م ل ك:B002/m01)
parent_channels.synthesis: Staying supplies repetition, familiarity supplies the resulting attachment, and dwelling gives that attachment a location. Possession turns habitual residence into settled control.

parent_channels.name: S2. Odor Absorbed and Released by Substance
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A material acquires another substance's scent and later presents it as fragrance or stench.
parent_channels.active_motifs: perceived odor (ر و ح:B004/m01); transfer of scent between substances (ر و ح:B004/m02); cooked contents (ق د ر:B007/m02); thick syrup or residue (ر ب ب:B006/m01)
parent_channels.synthesis: The thick or cooked material acts as a carrier, scent transfer changes its state, and smell is the perceiver's access to that change. Fragrance and stench are opposite outcomes of the same mechanism.

parent_channels.name: S3. Upward Expulsion from a Bounded Body
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Contents rise abruptly from an internal container and are expelled.
parent_channels.active_motifs: vomiting or rising emesis (ط ل ع:B011/m01); vessel-like containment (ق د ر:B007/m01); thick internal contents (ر ب ب:B006/m01); sudden disruptive onset (ف ج ر:B003/m01)
parent_channels.synthesis: The body is structured as a vessel, its contents as thick matter, and emesis as upward emergence. Sudden onset supplies the force and timing of expulsion.

parent_channels.name: S4. The “Sound” Snake-Bitten Person
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A harmed person is called sound either as an auspicious reversal or because the person has surrendered to the affliction.
parent_channels.active_motifs: snake-bitten patient (س ل م:B009/m01); auspicious naming by the opposite state (س ل م:B009/m02); surrender to the affliction (س ل م:B009/m03)
parent_channels.synthesis: The subchannel is a discourse relation built from contradiction: the name of safety marks actual injury. Its two internal explanations preserve either hoped-for recovery or completed submission.

parent_channels.name: S5. Alternating Exertion and Restored Capacity
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Workers alternate turns so that effort, rest, and renewed energy can sustain a task.
parent_channels.active_motifs: alternation between workers or tasks (ر و ح:B008/m01); effective capacity (ق د ر:B003/m01); vigor and force (ر و ح:B011/m01); eager initiative (ر و ح:B010/m01); restorative rest (ر و ح:B007/m01)
parent_channels.synthesis: Alternation distributes exertion, rest renews the worker, and capacity returns as force and initiative. The result is a repeatable labor cycle rather than a single burst of effort.
